Q&A: Fresh Electric Dirt Bike Player, Yozma, Is Attending EICMA With New IN11 – Here's What's Coming
14 photos
Photo: Cristian Curmei | Autoevolution
Ever since Yozma appeared on the scene back in 2025, they quickly swept across the US with their fun and capable electric mini dirt bikes. Well, they’re attending EICMA for the first time, and also showcasing their latest IN11 and 11 Pro, so, we decided to get in touch with the brand for a quick Q&A to see what’s in store here and where they’re headed.
If the name Yozma isn’t familiar to you, once you're done with this quick Q&A, your social media feed is sure to toss some ads at you. But, what you do need to know about Yozma is that they’re a rather new kid on the block, and instead of positing themselves against others like Sur-Ron, Talaria, and a few consecrated e-dirt bike brands, Yozma chose to supply a different segment of the market: off-road-loving mini dirt bikes.
Photo: Cristian Curmei | Autoevolution Building on the success of the IN10 and 10 Pro series bikes that carry a customer review rating of a minimum of 4.8 out of 5 stars, Yozma has decided to step up their lineup with the similar level of off-road-ready rides, but ones that can now carry out some stunts. Let’s see what Yozma has to say about the new series.
Our first question for the brand is one that reveals a bit about what the IN11 and 11 Pro lineup has in store for interested riders, and while it may an answer that is marketing-oriented, it does give us an idea of what gap the IN11 fills in Yozma’s lineup.
Autoevolution (AE) : For new riders just discovering Yozma, how would you define your brand's DNA and what was the vision behind creating both the IN11 and IN11 Pro series?
Yozma : " At Yozma, our DNA is 100% pure off-road excitement. We build strictly off-road electric dirt bikes designed for maximum control, instant torque, and pure riding fun without emissions. With the IN11 Series, we wanted to cater to different riding styles and skill levels.
The IN11 is our agile, playful, and stunt-ready bike—perfect for riders looking for dynamic fun, agility, and clever features like Auto-Wheelie Assist.
On the other hand, the IN11 PRO is built for extreme performance, higher power output, and riders who want to push boundaries on tough, challenging trails. "
Do take not of the fact that the 11 Pro does have a range of 85 km (53 miles) and a peak torque output of 245 Nm (181 lb-ft), so 45 Nm (33 lb-ft) more than the standard IN11.
Photo: Cristian Curmei | Autoevolution AE : How does the IN11 PRO step up performance for off-road enthusiasts?
Yozma : " The IN11 PRO - while it retains that core spirit of the standard IN11 and the Wheelie Assist and built-in Anti-Tip Protection - is engineered for riders looking for higher-tier performance and more aggressive off-road capability. Both models share our high standards for safety and agility, but the IN11 Pro is all about unlocking smart, stunt-ready fun . "
Simply put, Yozma is now chasing the stunt dragon that countless other brands on the market are now setting their sights on, but still reserves its off-road spirit with knobby tires, a plush suspension, and more kick than the standard models this brand has brought to market until now. Be sure to check out our previous coverage on the Yozma lineup to catch up if you’re not aware of who they are and what this crew brings to the table.
Photo: Cristian Curmei | Autoevolution AE : EICMA is the world’s biggest platform for two-wheelers. How do you see electric dirt bikes changing the off-road market, and what is Yozma’s roadmap for Europe and global markets moving forward?
Yozma : " The off-road sector is undergoing a massive transformation. Electric dirt bikes aren't just about zero emissions—they offer instant torque without gear shifting, minimal noise, which opens up more places to ride without disturbing nature or local communities, and dramatically lower maintenance costs.”
“EICMA 2026 is a major milestone for Yozma as we expand into European and international markets. We are establishing direct connections with local distributors, dealers, and the off-road community and are fully committed to building a strong global service network, supporting riders with reliable performance and continuously elevating the electric off-road experience. "
Photo: Cristian Curmei | Autoevolution Yes, Yozma is growing and setting its sights on one very important aspect of customer relations: the network of dealers and distributors, meaning that if we do need parts and servicing, we won’t need to stand by for weeks to months to be back on our ride, and if I may, I already tested Yozma’s ability to quickly meet our needs.
I’m currently testing an IN10 Pro and I initially thought I had an issue with the battery – I don’t, but Yozma felt we shouldn’t risk anything, even though the pack seems to be working within parameters – it's currently mounted in the 10 Pro. So, they decided to send a new one over, and if I may, within a week, the new pack was in my hands. Simply put, they already have distribution centers and parts replacement for my area.
Since we’re here at EICMA, we’ve also put together a video interview for Yozma and will be including it in some coverage that we run on the event. Keep your eyes peeled for content on our social media channels if you don’t feel like reading EICMA coverage.
